title: cubic joins Cohere
summary: Cohere has acquired cubic. The product will keep running and stay fully supported.
body_markdown:
Today, Cohere announced that it has acquired cubic.


We started cubic to make code review faster and more useful.


As we got to know the Cohere team, it became clear we could build something far better together than we could on our own. Joining Cohere lets us bring cubic to many more engineering teams.


## What this means for cubic


cubic isn't going anywhere. The product will keep running and stay fully supported, and we'll keep shipping improvements.


Our team is joining Cohere to keep building cubic.


## Thank you


To our customers: thank you for trusting us with such an important part of how you ship software.


Thank you also to our investors for backing us, and to our team for everything you've put into cubic.


We're looking forward to what comes next.


Paul
